TIMG.SE.I2.summary: A single street door from the *Decumanus* leads through a vestibule onto a ten-column court whose porticoes open onto nine small rooms, with a three-bayed reception room on the entrance axis where the figured mosaic lies. The house was redrawn on confidence-graded layers in September 2026, which gives sixteen spaces reached from one entrance, with two circulation rings running through the porticoes. The court is square, with a well and planters rather than the semicircular *atrium* of the later plans, the tripartite front of the reception room is confirmed, and no room opens directly onto the street, which points to a single household without shops along the frontage.

TIMG.E-SW.I1.summary: Entered from the east street through a seven-column portico and a columned hall, the house runs on one axis across a twelve-column court to an open *tablinum*, with a second, deeper court and its apsed *oecus* to the west and rows of street-entered rooms on the north and south sides. The house was redrawn on confidence-graded layers in October 2026, which gives fifty-six spaces, thirteen street doors on four streets and seventeen circulation rings, so no single room controls the way in. The shops along the south street connect to each other and to the street but reach the house itself only through one uncertain door and one certain one, which keeps work on the outside of the block and the household behind it, and the *tablinum* and the *oecus* sit among the least integrated spaces, where Fisher's table expects reception rooms to sit.
